observations: Photo 0 shows a white fat-tire electric bicycle with a frame decal reading "BMW", a frame-mounted battery pack, fat knobby tires, white rims, front and rear fenders, and a kickstand.
Photo 1 shows a similar white fat-tire electric bicycle with a "CALSSIC BIKE" sticker on the top tube, "KINO-CYCLE" on the fork, a headlight, frame battery, and white rims.
Both images carry a watermark for "ULTIMATE AMERICAN".
A second bicycle is visible in the background of photo 0.

claims.evidence: Seller's text only; no proof in photos

risks.risk: Motor or pedal-assist may not function
risks.proof: Video of the motor engaging under throttle or pedal assist

risks.risk: Frame may have hidden cracks or weld damage near the battery mount
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame joints, especially the head tube and battery mounting area

proof_requests: Video of the e-bike powering on with the battery connected and display or lights working
Video of the motor running under throttle or pedal assist
Close-up photos of the frame welds and battery mounting area
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a fat-tire electric bicycle, so it can be priced at its worst case as non-working even without proof of function.
